whitepaper_s1_p1: XCANNES (XCS) is a digital token designed to integrate into the economic ecosystem of Cannes and its region—an iconic destination known for its economic dynamism, international reach, and cultural activity.
whitepaper_s1_p2: XCANNES aims to support the city's digital transition by offering a digital currency that reflects Cannes' identity and exclusivity, while remaining accessible to everyone—including visitors and regional economic actors.

whitepaper_s2_li5: Scalable: up to 1,500 transactions per second.
whitepaper_s2_li6: Interoperable: compatible with other digital assets.

whitepaper_s2_p2: ⚜️ XRPL provides XCANNES with a robust, fast, and scalable infrastructure—perfectly suited for a modern city like Cannes.
whitepaper_s3_li1: A universal payment method across shops, hotels, restaurants, and local services.
whitepaper_s3_li2: Privileged access to offers and exclusive experiences in XCS.
whitepaper_s3_li3: Potential usage during landmark events (Cannes Film Festival, etc.).
whitepaper_s3_li4: Future development towards e-commerce and digital services.
whitepaper_s3_p1: XCANNES was designed to support and modernize the local economy by offering a digital payment method tailored to the needs of merchants, residents, and visitors.
whitepaper_s3_p2: XCANNES is more than a token: it is an economic lever and an innovation tool serving the city and its region.

home_v2_hero_speed_modal_subtitle: XCANNES uses the XRP Ledger (XRP) network to finalize transactions in seconds.
home_v2_hero_speed_modal_note: In rare network congestion, the delay can be slightly longer.
home_v2_hero_speed_modal_point_3: XCANNES commitment: < 3 s under normal conditions.
home_v2_hero_security_modal_subtitle: The XCANNES wallet relies on Xaman, a validation solution used by hundreds of thousands of users worldwide.
home_v2_hero_security_modal_point_1: Your funds remain under your control.
home_v2_hero_security_modal_point_2: Every transaction must be approved by you.
home_v2_hero_security_modal_point_3: No action can be executed without your consent.
home_v2_hero_security_modal_note: Neither XCANNES nor Xaman can access your funds or act on your behalf.
home_v2_hero_security_modal_section_trus: Xaman is a recognized non-custodial wallet in the digital assets ecosystem, used by services, businesses, and users worldwide.
Its principle is simple: the user keeps control; the platform does not intervene in validation.
home_v2_hero_security_modal_section_reg_: Architecture without custody of funds, without key management by the platform, with explicit user validation.
Aligned with major regulatory directions (e.g., MiCA in Europe, the United States). Xaman is validation software, not a financial intermediary.
home_v2_hero_security_modal_section_role: Final validation and transaction security rely on Xaman and your confirmation.
home_v2_hero_security_modal_section_summ: You keep control of your funds.
Xaman is a recognized and widely used solution.
XCANNES holds neither your funds nor your keys.
home_v2_hero_fees_modal_point_1: XRPL network fee on each on-chain transaction.
home_v2_hero_fees_modal_point_2: No separate XCANNES fees: the cost is a FX spread.
home_v2_hero_fees_modal_point_4: Conversion rates: Pyth when available, otherwise FX EOD (1x/day).
home_v2_hero_fees_modal_note: New currency activation: one-time payment in RLUSD.
home_v2_hero_pillar_4_desc: Stable as the dollar. Accessible in any currency.
home_v2_hero_value_modal_subtitle: Local amounts are shown, the USD reference stays stable.
home_v2_hero_value_modal_point_1: Your reference value is in USD (RLUSD).
home_v2_hero_value_modal_point_2: Local amounts are indicative, based on market rates.
home_v2_hero_value_modal_point_3: You can convert anytime, with the rate shown before confirmation.
home_v2_hero_value_modal_note: Local display can move with FX; the reference remains RLUSD.
home_v2_hero_security_modal_biometrics: Biometric validation on your device (fingerprint/Face ID).
home_v2_hero_security_modal_xrpl_native: Native XRPL transactions: on-chain validation, no intermediary.
home_v2_essentials_convert_lines_desc: Activate your local currencies and convert with the rate shown before validation.
home_v2_essentials_convert_lines_modal_i: Two flows: convert a currency or manage your account lines.
home_v2_essentials_3_modal_intro: Convert between local currencies with the rate shown before validation.
home_v2_essentials_3_modal_flow_1_intro: Choose the source currency and the target currency, then confirm.
home_v2_essentials_3_modal_flow_1_step_1: Select the source currency and the target currency.
home_v2_essentials_3_modal_flow_1_step_3: The rate, received amount, and any fees appear before confirmation.
home_v2_essentials_3_modal_flow_1_step_4: An RLUSD transaction covers the fees; your lines update.
home_v2_essentials_3_modal_flow_1_note: Depending on the pair, conversion uses the XRPL market (XRP/XCS) or an internal RLUSD reallocation.
home_v2_essentials_lines_modal_flow_1_in: An account line is a local currency activated in your wallet, ready for payments, conversions, and receipts.
home_v2_essentials_lines_modal_flow_1_st: Choose a local currency and activate the corresponding line.
A one-time fee of 1 USD (≈ 1 RLUSD) applies on activation.
Once activated, the line is ready to use:
Pay or receive in this currency
Balance updates automatically with the current rate
You can manage your line at any time. Deactivation is only possible when the balance is zero.
Deactivation also incurs a one-time fee of 1 USD (≈ 1 RLUSD).
